cues.text:
I brought the pieces
I could not mend

The things I promised
I'd never do again

I brought the questions
I tried to hide

Every reason
I thought You'd turn aside

But You never asked
For a better version of me

You only said
Come

I bring You what I am
You give me who You are

I bring the wounded places
You meet me where they are

I bring You empty hands
You fill this weary heart

I don't have to hide
I don't have to run

You say
Come as you are

I thought that mercy
Was something earned

That I should fix myself
Before I could return

But grace was waiting
Before I knew

I came with nothing
And found everything in You

You never asked
For perfection at the door

You only said
Come

I bring You what I am
You give me who You are

I bring the wounded places
You meet me where they are

I bring You empty hands
You fill this weary heart

I don't have to hide
I don't have to run

You say
Come as you are
When I am tired

Come
When I am burdened

Come
When I have failed again

Come
When I am ashamed

Come
Not when I'm stronger

Not when I'm whole
Not when I've earned it

Come
Come to the mercy

Come to the grace
Come to the Savior
He knows your name

I bring You what I am
You give me who You are

I bring the wounded places
You meet me where they are

I bring You empty hands
You fill this weary heart

I don't have to hide
I don't have to run

You say
Come as you are

I bring You all my weakness
You give me all Your grace

I bring You every failure
You never turn Your face

Nothing left to prove
Nothing left to earn

Only open arms
And one invitation
Come as you are
I bring You what I am
You give me who You are
